transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here because I feel like I’m always running hot—like I can’t shut the motor off. Lately it’s been getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
Did you feel this sense of having a running motor when you were a child?
Yeah. My mom says I was like that even in grade school—always getting out of my seat, blurting out answers, losing my homework. I’d get notes sent home, even though I was smart enough to do the work.
Nowadays, do you have trouble keeping your focus on tasks or activities at work or at home?
Yeah. In briefings or drone training, I’m focused for the first few minutes, then I kind of realize I’ve been staring at the map or screen and missed half of what command said.
